_doc: Explicit per-combo EXPECTED-TIER whitelist for the Commander Spellbook combo-recall bench. STATELESS INVARIANT: for EACH eligible combo (every card has a gold fixture), the engine's CURRENT reconstruction tier MUST equal the expectedTier pinned here. ANY drift fails loudly and per-combo: a REGRESSION (e.g. Green->Amber, Amber->Missed) is a real coverage loss; an IMPROVEMENT (e.g. Missed->Amber) also fails, with the message 'update the pin for <combo>' — a coverage gain is a deliberate, reviewed pin edit, never a silent moving baseline. A combo present in the run but absent here (or vice-versa) also fails (the whitelist is a list of NAMES, not an aggregate count). The aggregate recall numbers in bench-report.json are a DERIVED REPORT (regenerated by `dotnet run -- --write`), NOT the gate; this file is the gate. Seeded from the run on 2026-06-16 (5 Green / 18 Amber / 10 Missed of 33 eligible).
